policies.protocol: admission receipt grammar `blp-admission-{64 lowercase hex}.receipt`, turn status `running`, token=SHA256(native nonce) and typed refusal codes are protocol invariants; zero-matching-receipts Ok is the declared legacy fast path, not an operator switch
policies.operator: no new execution policy, default classification, timeout, retry, cap or watchdog; the gate adds no budget consumption, no reservation and no saved-setting write
policies.fixtures: fixture tokens (fixture-admin-token/fixture-sender-token/fixture-reader-token), PRIVATE_FIXTURE_KEY and the .swarm-fixtures roots are test inputs; the fixture registers its own PID/stamp/host by writing the row directly — declared fixture injection, never enrollment evidence
policies.resources: no timeout added anywhere; the recipe keeps JOBS=1 for cache-stable assertions and no global watchdog exists

functions: RootStore::preparation_worker_transport_gate: egress-wrapped entry (shared re-entry never blocks; quarantine snapshot re-checked, strictly no weaker); doc-comment states contract, refusal codes, non-effects and non-grants

worker_transport_gate: gated_turn under with_material_read → exact-grammar receipt scan over names() (non-admission names never read; valid-format but unreadable/undecodable refuses blp-admission-not-found/blp-admission-record-invalid — fail-closed, no silent pass) → empty match returns Ok before any Trust read → >=1 match: reserve_trust(false) after the scan (lock order egress→material→scan→trust→close) → State decode/validate/require_supported, current Entry required (blp-policy-required) → per receipt full preparation_admission::verify with the receipt's principal (caller never supplies identity) → custody.settings_digest vs current_settings_digest (blp-transport-settings-changed) → resolve_destination from the turn's provider with mandatory worker base_url/model echo (blp-destination-echo-mismatch; closes claim→send TOCTOU) → per receipt provider_source/settings freshness vs captured values → destination_digest over the resolved account → entry.attribution_for on the recomputed digest for this project root (blp-destination-not-attributed) → per receipt provenance classifications under current entry + ExecutionDomain::prepare re-derivation under CURRENT policy (no-write-down) + output-classification equality + check_output(Some(label)) → observe_budget read-only → finished folds lock-close failures

TurnCustody/gated_turn (preparation_call.rs): re-read under material guard; requires exactly running, token==SHA256(nonce), PID/stamp/host == SupervisorIdentity::current(), unchanged root instance; exposes only turn + request_level + settings_digest; prompt/provenance/nonce stay private; doc-comment declares observation-not-authority

preparation_worker run (swarm-cli): gate call is the first statement, before any Request object exists; call site wraps run in with_preparation_egress; CLI path (preparation_call_cli.rs) keeps its own egress control and was not modified

destination_digest/resolve_destination/observe_budget/current_settings_digest: reviewed unchanged BLP-05 helpers as consumed — resolve_destination reads the live catalogue (TOCTOU pin), observe_budget is rollback-only and refuses unavailable preparations, current_settings_digest refuses truncated/missing history

preparation_admission::verify signature consumed as (root, state, principal, admission) -> Result<usize,E>: schema, identity digest, instance, revisions, policy digest, per-source re-join, output label — re-run per matched receipt

test preparation_worker_transport.rs: fixture under .swarm-fixtures (never /tmp), birth marker, 0600 config files, self-cleaning; ordering constraints encoded (admission before any send — preparation-turn-active; claim before gate; one active turn — legacy turn finished before bound turn); same event_id for admission and bound turn (request_hash covers event_id — verified empirically and by capture source: request_hash = hash(encode_model(send))); refusals asserted: wrong token, unattributed destination, wrong base_url echo, wrong model echo; exact pass asserted with reservation count before==after+claims (gate adds none)

errors.authentication: the worker holds no principal: identity always comes from the receipt's re-verified record; custody requires the turn this very process claimed (running + token + PID/stamp/host) so another process's turn never gates through
errors.data: non-receipt directory names are skipped without IO; receipt grammar mismatches never read; undecodable matching receipts refuse typed instead of authorizing; admission/turn field mismatch simply does not match (no error) — legacy semantics
errors.storage: Trust reservation taken only after >=1 match and inside the already-held egress reservation; finished() folds lock-close failures preserving the primary refusal; names()/read_native_receipt IO errors propagate as Storage, only absence maps to blp-admission-not-found
errors.effects: gate performs no provider IO, no reservation and no SQL write; budget observation is rollback-only; refusals happen before the request struct is built, so no socket opens
errors.cleanup: egress wrapper cleanup folding unchanged; test fixture removes its root (asserted in fixture drop); no /tmp allocation anywhere in the increment
errors.http: no new HTTP surface in this increment (worker-side call); all refusal codes reused from the BLP-05 typed families
